https://pokemondb.net/red-blue/gymleaders-elitefour | Full team rosters for every Gym leader (Brock, Misty, Lt. Surge, Erika, Koga, Sabrina, Blaine, Giovanni) and the four Elite 4 members (Lorelei, Bruno, Agatha, Lance). | | 2 | From Step 1 we extracted the **unique** Pokémon that appear on those teams (see the list above). | Lists 38 different species, e.g., Geodude, Onix, Staryu, …, Dragonite. | | 3 | **Fandom – “Psychic (move)/Generation I”**
https://pokemon.fandom.com/wiki/Psychic_(move)/Generation_I | A table of every Gen I Pokémon that *learns* Psychic by level‑up. That table lists only: Alakazam, Kadabra, Drowzee, Hypno, Slowbro, Slowpoke, Mew, Mewtwo. | | 4 | Intersect the two sets → Alakazam, Kadabra, Slowbro. | These are the only Pokémon appearing on a Gym‑leader or Elite 4 team **and** learning Psychic by level‑up in Gen 1. | No other Pokémon from the teams can learn Psychic solely through leveling up in Generation 1 (the others learn it via TM/HM or never learn it at all). --- **Answer:** **Alakazam, Kadabra, Slowbro**.
